frmuenstertower.name: Freiburg Minster
frmuenstertower.slogan: A lace-stone spire that has watched the market since 1330.
frmuenstertower.line: The Gothic tower, 116 metres tall, was completed in 1330 and its spire is pierced all the way up with open stonework.

freuropapark.name: Europa-Park
freuropapark.slogan: A whole continent of rides on the edge of the Black Forest.
freuropapark.line: Opened on 12 July 1975 on 16 hectares, it now draws over 5 million visitors a year.

frvogtsbauernhof.name: Vogtsbauernhof
frvogtsbauernhof.slogan: Thatched roofs and woodsmoke, as Black Forest farmers lived.
frvogtsbauernhof.line: The museum is centred on a farmhouse from 1612, and opened to visitors in 1964.

frkaufhaus.name: Historisches Kaufhaus
frkaufhaus.slogan: Red walls, four emperors and a market square to match.
frkaufhaus.line: Finished in 1532, its facade carries statues of Maximilian I, Philip the Handsome, Charles V and Ferdinand I.

frfeldbergturm.name: Feldberg Tower
frfeldbergturm.slogan: Stand on the Black Forest's roof and look toward the Alps.
frfeldbergturm.line: At 1,494 metres, the Feldberg is the highest mountain in Germany outside the Alps and Bavaria.
